Plain ASCII, then Mac Roman: café, naïve, “quotes”, ‘single’, en – em —, ellipsis…, ©, ™, °.

Beyond Mac Roman: ａｅｓｔｈｅｔｉｃ, an arrow →, a check ✓, an emoji 😀, the euro €.

echo "code keeps its bytes"
